strings.zh: 圣柱王『Reeee——gi！{SCROLL}圣柱王是神殿的守卫,{NEWLINE}必须要打败它才能登上台阶。{CLEAR}要向圣柱王发起挑战吗？
strings.en: Regigigas: Reeee-gi!{SCROLL}Regigigas guards the temple.{NEWLINE}You must defeat it to climb the{CLEAR}steps. Challenge Regigigas?

strings.zh: 圣柱王『Reeee——gi！
strings.en: Regigigas: Reeee-gi!

strings.zh: 身上正好带着{NEWLINE}天界之笛、帝牙卢卡、帕路奇亚、骑拉帝纳,{CLEAR}要用它们召唤阿尔宙斯吗？
strings.en: You happen to have the Azure Flute,{NEWLINE}Dialga, Palkia and Giratina with{CLEAR}you. Use them to summon Arceus?

strings.zh: 阿尔宙斯『Aaaaa——ceus！
strings.en: Arceus: Aaaaa-ceus!

strings.zh: 阿尔宙斯『Aaaaa——ceus！{SCROLL}阿尔宙斯注视着你,{NEWLINE}似乎在等待着你的到来。{CLEAR}要尝试收服阿尔宙斯吗？
strings.en: Arceus: Aaaaa-ceus!{SCROLL}Arceus is watching you. It seems{NEWLINE}to have been waiting for you{CLEAR}to come. Try to catch Arceus?

strings.zh: 茜罗娜『{VAR:FF00:1}光之舞台{VAR:FF00:0}{NEWLINE}描绘着创造了世界的精灵们。{SCROLL}正中央的圆里,是万物之源阿尔宙斯……{SCROLL}
strings.en: Cynthia: Depicted on the {VAR:FF00:1}Mystri Stage{VAR:FF00:0}{NEWLINE}are the Pokémon that shaped{CLEAR}this world.{SCROLL}The circle in the middle is Arceus,{NEWLINE}the origin of it all...{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 茜罗娜『在古代文献中说{NEWLINE}一旦阿尔宙斯立于{VAR:FF00:1}光之舞台{VAR:FF00:0}之上,{CLEAR}时间和空间以及反物质世界,{NEWLINE}就此诞生。{SCROLL}
strings.en: Cynthia: Ancient texts say that once{NEWLINE}Arceus stands on the {VAR:FF00:1}Mystri Stage{VAR:FF00:0},{CLEAR}time, space and the world of{CLEAR}antimatter are born.{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0146/6; modernised from US 0146#6 | RV050: addition: US added 'or what combined we call the world'

strings.zh: 茜罗娜『这是掌管空间的{NEWLINE}帕路奇亚的纹章……{SCROLL}
strings.en: Cynthia: This is the pattern that{NEWLINE}represents Palkia, the master{CLEAR}of space...{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0146/7; modernised from US 0146#7 | RV050: addition: 'and dimensions' not in zh

strings.zh: 茜罗娜『这是掌管时间的{NEWLINE}帝牙卢卡的纹章……{SCROLL}还有……{SCROLL}
strings.en: Cynthia: This is the pattern that{NEWLINE}represents Dialga, the guardian of{CLEAR}time... And...{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0146/8; modernised from US 0146#8 | RV050: omission: restored trailing 还有…… (And...)

strings.zh: 茜罗娜『这是骑拉帝纳……{NEWLINE}这个世界的反面,{CLEAR}它与时间、空间相对,{CLEAR}掌管着反转的世界……{SCROLL}
strings.en: Cynthia: This is Giratina...{NEWLINE}It stands on the reverse side of this{CLEAR}world, opposite time and space, and{CLEAR}rules the reversed world...{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0146/9; modernised from US 0146#9 | RV050: meaning: US 'world of antimatter' replaced zh: reverse side, opposed to time and space, rules reversed world

strings.zh: 茜罗娜『你是被阿尔宙斯{NEWLINE}认可的训练师。{SCROLL}创造出宇宙的阿尔宙斯的力量{CLEAR}即使只展现出一部分,{SCROLL}这力量或许也足以从无的状态,{CLEAR}诞生出新的生命！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Cynthia: You are a Trainer whom Arceus{NEWLINE}has acknowledged.{SCROLL}Arceus created the universe. Even if it{NEWLINE}shows only part of its power, that{CLEAR}power may be enough to bring new life{CLEAR}into being out of nothing!{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0146/10; modernised from US 0146#10 | RV050: meaning: US 'is said to show you a glimpse' changed meaning; zh: even part of its power may create life from nothing

strings.zh: 茜罗娜『你从这３个圆中{NEWLINE}选中一个的时候,{CLEAR}应该就会发生些什么……{SCROLL}在此之前,{NEWLINE}请做好准备工作。
strings.en: Cynthia: It seems that something{NEWLINE}will happen when you choose one{CLEAR}of the three circles...{SCROLL}You’ll want to be well prepared.

strings.zh: 茜罗娜『准备好了的话,{NEWLINE}选择３个圆中的其中一个,{CLEAR}就可以了。{SCROLL}试试看站到圆的中心。
strings.en: Cynthia: Once you are ready, choose{NEWLINE}one of the three circles and stand in{CLEAR}the middle of it.

strings.zh: 茜罗娜『选择掌管时间的{NEWLINE}帝牙卢卡吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Cynthia: So you choose Dialga,{NEWLINE}the guardian of time? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 茜罗娜『选择掌管空间的{NEWLINE}帕路奇亚吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Cynthia: So you choose Palkia, the{NEWLINE}master of space? {VAR:0200:0}
strings.notes: US 0146/14; modernised from US 0146#14 | RV050: addition: 'and dimensions' not in zh

strings.zh: 茜罗娜『反转世界之王{NEWLINE}骑拉帝纳吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Cynthia: So you choose Giratina,{NEWLINE}the ruler of the Distortion World? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 茜罗娜『刚才发光的球体……{NEWLINE}难道说是……{CLEAR}蛋？{SCROLL}前所未见的蛋{NEWLINE}我们竟有幸亲眼见证了它{CLEAR}诞生的瞬间……　{SCROLL}
strings.en: Cynthia: That shining sphere just now...{NEWLINE}Could it be... an Egg?{SCROLL}An Egg like none ever seen before...{NEWLINE}and we were lucky enough to witness the{CLEAR}very moment it was born...{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0146/16 | RV050: meaning: 前所未见的蛋 = an unprecedented Egg; 有幸 dropped

strings.zh: 茜罗娜『蛋是孕育{NEWLINE}一切生命的摇篮。{SCROLL}我们居住的这个星球也正如{NEWLINE}蛋一般……{SCROLL}从蛋中诞生的生命{NEWLINE}总有一天会燃尽。{CLEAR}然后,{CLEAR}作为新的生命再度诞生……{SCROLL}阿尔宙斯或许是想让我们{CLEAR}见证这一切……{SCROLL}
strings.en: Cynthia: An Egg is the cradle of all life.{NEWLINE}This planet we live on is just{CLEAR}like an Egg...{SCROLL}Life born from an Egg will burn out{NEWLINE}one day. And then it will be born{CLEAR}again as new life...{SCROLL}Perhaps Arceus wanted us to witness{NEWLINE}all of this...{SCROLL}{NEWLINE}
strings.notes: US 0146/17; modernised from US 0146#17 | RV050: meaning: 燃尽 burn out / 作为新的生命再度诞生 restored

strings.zh: 茜罗娜『刚才那是？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Cynthia: What was that just now?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 茜罗娜『巨大的能量漩涡再次出现了！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Cynthia: That huge vortex of energy{NEWLINE}has appeared again!{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0146/19 | RV050: meaning: 巨大的能量漩涡再次出现 (D-1720)

strings.zh: 茜罗娜『果然是……阿尔宙斯！{SCROLL}我感觉到的力之源头{CLEAR}确实就是阿尔宙斯！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Cynthia: Of course... Arceus!{SCROLL}So the source of the power I’ve felt{NEWLINE}was Arceus!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 茜罗娜『{VAR:FF00:1}神都遗迹{VAR:FF00:0}是{NEWLINE}新奥地区的人们{CLEAR}为了供奉阿尔宙斯{CLEAR}而建造的……{SCROLL}几百年来,{NEWLINE}一直等待着阿尔宙斯的降临的{CLEAR}被冰雪覆盖的神殿……{SCROLL}
strings.en: Cynthia: What is now the {VAR:FF00:1}Sinjoh Ruins{NEWLINE}{VAR:FF00:0}was built to honor Arceus by the{CLEAR}Sinnoh people...{SCROLL}It’s an icebound temple that has been{NEWLINE}waiting for Arceus for hundreds{CLEAR}of years...{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 茜罗娜『这里是{VAR:FF00:1}光之舞台{VAR:FF00:0}{SCROLL}为了引出阿尔宙斯{NEWLINE}的力量而建造的。{SCROLL}
strings.en: Cynthia: This is the {VAR:FF00:1}Mystri Stage{VAR:FF00:0}.{SCROLL}It is designed to bring out the power{NEWLINE}Arceus possesses.{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 茜罗娜『阿尔宙斯是{NEWLINE}世间万物的起源。{SCROLL}创造出宇宙一切生命的源头。{SCROLL}神话中描述的阿尔宙斯的力量,{NEWLINE}于{VAR:FF00:1}光之舞台{VAR:FF00:0}之上,{CLEAR}得以解放！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Cynthia: Arceus is described in{NEWLINE}mythology as being the origin of{CLEAR}everything and the source of{CLEAR}all beings.{SCROLL}It is said that the power of Arceus{NEWLINE}is released on the {VAR:FF00:1}Mystri Stage{VAR:FF00:0}!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 茜罗娜『这个{VAR:FF00:1}神都遗迹{VAR:FF00:0}是{NEWLINE}为了供奉阿尔宙斯{CLEAR}而建造起来的神殿。
strings.en: Cynthia: The {VAR:FF00:1}Sinjoh Ruins{VAR:FF00:0} are a temple{NEWLINE}built to worship Arceus.
strings.notes: US 0146/24; modernised from US 0146#24 | RV050: softened: 供奉 = worship/enshrine, stronger than 'show respect'

strings.zh: 不可思议的玉变成了精灵！{SCROLL}
strings.en: The mysterious round object{NEWLINE}took the shape of a Pokémon!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}{NEWLINE}得到了{VAR:0100:1}！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0} obtained{NEWLINE}the {VAR:0100:1}!

strings.zh: 选择帝牙卢卡吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Will you choose Dialga? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 选择帕路奇亚吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Will you choose Palkia? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 选择骑拉帝纳吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Will you choose Giratina? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 这里似乎没有反应……
strings.en: This place does not seem to respond...

strings.zh: 似乎有资格站在这里的只有阿尔宙斯…！
strings.en: It seems only Arceus is worthy of{NEWLINE}standing here...!
strings.notes: US 0146/31; modernised from US 0146#31 | RV050: meaning: 只有阿尔宙斯 = only Arceus, not 'a single Arceus' (D-1718)

strings.zh: 给{VAR:0100:1}{NEWLINE}取昵称吗？{VAR:0200:0}
strings.en: Would you like to give a nickname{NEWLINE}to the {VAR:0100:1}? {VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 阿尔宙斯似乎……{NEWLINE}已经没反应了！
strings.en: Arceus seems to... have stopped{NEWLINE}responding!
strings.notes: US 0146/33; modernised from US 0146#33 | RV050: meaning: subject is Arceus (D-1719)

strings.zh: 帝牙卢卡『Diaaaa——ga！
strings.en: Dialga: Diaaaa-ga!

strings.zh: 帕路奇亚『Paaaa——kia！
strings.en: Palkia: Paaaa-kia!

strings.zh: 骑拉帝纳『Giiii——ra！
strings.en: Giratina: Giiii-ra!
